Rooms.Name: The Entrance to the Great Elven City of Illir
Rooms.Description:
You are entering the great elven city of Illir. Many elves are 
passing by you on the path that leads to the gates. Before you 
are the walls that surround the city. The only way in is the gates 
that is guarded by armed elves.

Exits.Description: You see the gates that guard the elven city.
You see a forest.

Rooms.Name: Inside the Gates of the Great Elven City of Illir
Rooms.Description:
You are inside the gates of Illir. Everywhere you see elves walking 
around and there is a sound of elven smiths forging weapons and armors. 
As you look north you see some kind of market square and to the east a 
large tree can be seen.

Exits.Description: You see a market square.
You see the mighty gates of Illir.
You look upon another part of the city.
You see an enormous tree.

Rooms.Name: In the City of Illir
Rooms.Description:
You are in the great elven city of Illir. There are many houses 
around you and elves are busy working. To the south you see a smith.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the elven smith.
You see some houses inside the gates.
You see a guard house near a small river.

Rooms.Name: Under a Great Tree
Rooms.Description:
You stand under a very large tree with leaves that are shining like 
gold. As you look up into the tree you see a ladder that leads up 
through the tree. To the west the city gates can be seen.

Exits.Description: Inside the gates.
In the elven city of Illir.
Up in the large tree.

Rooms.Name: A Guard House Before the Bridge
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at a guard house at a river. Elven 
guards watch for intruders at a bridge that leads over 
a swift stream. Far away you can see the mountains from 
which the river seems to come.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the Dancing Duck.
You see some sort of market.
You see another part of the city.
You see a bridge that leads over the stream.

Rooms.Name: The Market Square of Illir
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the middle of a market. Here elves come to buy 
their food or to trade things. There are musicians playing and even 
some elves dancing.

Exits.Description: You see a path that leads to a large house.
You see another part of the city.
You see the gates of the elven city.
You see a bridge that leads over a stream.

Rooms.Name: The Elven City of Illir
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in another part of the elven city. To the west it 
seems that the elves are holding some sort of market and to the north 
more houses can be seen.

Exits.Description: The northeast corner of the city.
You see a great tree.
You see the market square of Illir.

Rooms.Name: The Dancing Duck
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the Dancing Duck. Here elves come to 
feast and to get a good nights sleep. The innkeeper is busy serving 
elves food and wine and there are musicians playing in a corner.

Exits.Description: You see a guard house near a stream.

Rooms.Name: On the Trail to a Great Elven House
Rooms.Description:
You are walking on a trail that leads up to a house of great 
beauty. The path doesn't seem to be made of mortals as it seems 
to shine on its own. To the south you can see the market square.
There are some guards on the path that stare threateningly at you.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to a great house.
You see some houses in the distance.
As you look back you see the market square.

Rooms.Name: Another part of the city
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a part of the elven city that is dominated by 
the houses where the elves live. Here most of the mothers and their 
children spend their time waiting for the fathers to come home 
from their duties.

Exits.Description: As you look south you can see that the city continues.
You see a trail that goes up in the woods.

Rooms.Name: In the Smithy
Rooms.Description:
You are in an elven smithy. Many young elves are working hard and 
before you an old elf is hammering on an anvil. The sound of battering 
iron is so loud that you want to cover your ears. The only way out is 
the door to the north.

Exits.Description: You see some houses.

Rooms.Name: Up in the large tree
Rooms.Description:
You are climbing a very large tree. Elven guards are sitting on the
limbs of the tree and you also see children playing around. As you look
up you can see that another ladder leads even further up into the tree.

Exits.Description: The ladder goes even higher up into the great tree.
You see the ground under the great tree.

Rooms.Name: At the Top of the Tree
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a house that is built in the great tree. Torches 
are hanging on the walls and there seems to be food stored everywhere. 
As you look around you also see many elven guards approaching you with 
haste. It doesn't like they want you here!

Exits.Description: You see the rope ladder that leads down from the tree.

Rooms.Name: The Bridge over the Stream
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a bridge that leads over a swift stream. The 
stream comes down from the imposing mountains that can be seen in 
the north. The area west of the bridge seems to be very wild and 
desolate compared to the city of the elves.

Exits.Description: You see the guard house before the bridge.
You see the hills which are below the mountains.

Rooms.Name: The Beginning of the Trail to the Mountains
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a path that leads up to the mountains. As you move
on you notice that you are not the only living being on this path. Many
signs show that orcs have been on this path not long ago.

Exits.Description: The trail goes on through the hills.
You see the bridge that leads over the stream.
You see a trail that goes south down to the stream.

Rooms.Name: On the Trail Towards the Mountains
Rooms.Description:
You are walking on the trail that leads up to the mountain that 
can be seen in the east.

Exits.Description: The trail continues.
You see the trail as it goes down to the bridge.

Rooms.Name: On the Trail Towards the Mountains
Rooms.Description: You are on the trail that leads up to the moutains.

Exits.Description: The trail seems to be lesser used to the north.
You see the trail as it goes down by the hills.

Rooms.Name: In a Bend of the Trail Towards the Mountains
Rooms.Description:
The trail seems to be used very little here up in the hills. 
Everywhere bushes and grass are growing on the trail and sometimes 
some evil noise makes your heart stop for awhile.

Exits.Description: The trail continues south.
The trail goes directly towards the mountains.

Rooms.Name: Near the Misty Mountains
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on the trail that leads up from the elven city 
to the mountains. As you look west you see that the mountains are 
covered with snow and that seems unusual at this time of year.

Exits.Description:
A trail that leads from the mountains seems to turn south after a 
little while.
You see the mountains that are very close now.

Rooms.Name: At the Foot of the Misty Mountains
Rooms.Description:
You are standing just outside the eastern entrance to the mines of 
Moria. The snowclad mountain seems to darken your thoughts and hope as 
it casts its shadow upon you. Everywhere the sound of orcs and other 
foul creatures gets nearer.

Exits.Description: A trail leads down from the mountains.
You see the eastern entrance to Moria.

Rooms.Name: The Eastern Entrance to Moria
Rooms.Description:
You are standing inside the entrance that goes into Moria from the 
east. The signs of marauding orcs can be seen everywhere and you also 
see some trees that have been burned just for pleasure. As you look 
further in you see only darkness.

Exits.Description: You see the hills outside of Moria.
You see endless darkness.

Rooms.Name: At a swift Stream
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the side of a stream that is making its way 
down from the mountains. To the east the golden woods of Lothlorien 
can be seen and you wonder if you dare to enter. There seems to be 
a small path going along the stream.

Exits.Description: In the distance you see a bridge.
You see a great river and some elven ships.

Rooms.Name: The Entrance to the Royal Elven House
Rooms.Description:
You are standing before the doors of the house where the elven king 
and queen live. There are guards on both sides of the door and it 
doesn't look like you are invited.

Exits.Description: You see the doors of the house.
You see the city of the Elves.

Rooms.Name: In the Great Elven House
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the elven house where the king and queen live. 
There are guards patrolling just outside and you can see servants 
working in the halls of the house. The hallway continues north but 
there is also a small door to the east.

Exits.Description: You see the trees outside the house.
You see a joint in the hallway.
You see a small door made of oak.

Rooms.Name: A hallway in the elven house
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a hallway in the elven house. To the west a 
small door can be seen and to the east you hear the sounds of elves 
singing.

Exits.Description: You see a small door made of oak.
You see the entrance to a room that appears filled with singing elves.

Rooms.Name: The Room of Pleasures
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the entrance to a room where the elves go to 
listen and take part in the choirs singing or to hear the lords tell 
stories about orcs and goblins. In the middle of the room there is a 
dark-haired old elf with a large sword in a sheet. As you look upon 
him you understand that this is a very mighty man.

Exits.Description: You see the hall that leads out from the room.

Rooms.Name: At a Nexus in the Hall
Rooms.Description:
You have come to the place where the hallway that comes from the 
entrance of the house divides in every direction.

Exits.Description: You see that the hall continues north.
A narrow hall continues east.
You see the hall that goes towards the entrance of the house.
You the hall that goes towards the kitchen.

Rooms.Name: In a Small Hallway
Rooms.Description: You are standing in a hallway that goes east-west.

Exits.Description: You see a Nexus in the hallway.
You see the end of the hallway.

Rooms.Name: At the End of the Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You have come to the end of the hallway. There are no elves present 
and you wonder why. In the east part of the room you can see a large 
fireplace that is covered with dust.

Exits.Description: You see the hallway continue east.
You see that there are some strange details on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: You see that there is a trigger on the side of the fireplace.

Rooms.Name: At the Entrance to the Kitchen
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the entrance of the kitchen where the elven 
cooks are preparing meals for the royal court. There is a sweet 
smell and you start too drool as you haven't eaten a decent meal for 
a long time.

Exits.Description: You see a nexus in the hallway.
You see the middle of the elven kitchen.

Rooms.Name: The Kitchen of the Elves
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the place where all food is prepared for the 
elven queen and king. There are also many elves making lembas for 
the traveling elves.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to the kitchen.

Rooms.Name: In the Main Hallway
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the hallway that goes from the entrance of the 
great elven house to the stairs that can be see in the north. Some 
elves are moving around carrying food for the court upstairs.

Exits.Description: You see a nexus in the Hallway.
You see the stairs that goes up.

Rooms.Name: At the Bottom of the Stairs
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the foot of the spiral stairs that lead up to 
the second floor of the great elven house. These stairs seem very 
ancient and were probably made by dwarves milleniums ago.

Exits.Description: You see the hallway that leads south.
You see the spiral stairs go up, and up, and up......

Rooms.Name: At the Top of the Stairs
Rooms.Description:
You reach the top of the stairs and come to the great halls 
of the elven court. To the south two great thrones can be seen and 
there are elven guards everywhere.

Exits.Description: You see the stairs go down.
You see the hall of the elven court.

Rooms.Name: In a Hall in the Elven Court
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a hall where the elven court is located. To the 
south the throne of the elven queen and king can be seen, and to the 
east and west there are guards watching you.

Exits.Description: You see the stairs.
You see a small alcove that is guarded by a royal guard.
You see the Thrones of the king and queen.
You see a small alcove that is guarded by a royal guard.

Rooms.Name: An Alcove in the Royal Hall
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small alcove that is used by the royal elven
guards. There are weapons hanging on the walls and you can also see 
paintings made centuries ago.

Exits.Description: You see the hall of the elven court.

Rooms.Name: An Alcove in the Royal Hall
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a small alcove that is used by the royal elven
guards. There are weapons hanging on the walls and you can also see
paintings that seem to be made centuries ago.

Exits.Description: You see the hall of the elven court.

Rooms.Name: The Thrones of the Elven Queen and King
Rooms.Description:
You are standing before the elven queen and king who are sitting on
their thrones. They seem to be very mighty and you get a strong urge 
to run away from this place. At the same time you are caught by the 
beauty of the elven queen whom you have never seen before.

Exits.Description: You see the hallway of the elven court.

You see that there seems to be some sort of hidden room behind the 
throne.
You see a door on the roof that leads to an attic.

Rooms.Name: The Attic of the Elven House
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in an attic where nobody seems to have stepped  
foot for a long time. There are bats sleeping under the roof and 
you can see many things lying on the ground covered by dust.

Exits.Description: You look down on the thrones of the elven queen and king.

Rooms.Name: A Secret Hall Behind the Thrones
Rooms.Description:
You have come to a secret hall behind the thrones of the elven 
queen and king. There are many great paintings of elves and the 
other free people of Middle earth. As you look south you can see 
some sort of mirror that shines on its own and you think that it 
would be clever not to go that way.

Exits.Description: You see the elven thrones.
You see the mirror of Galadriel.

Rooms.Name: The Mirror of Galadriel
Rooms.Description:
As you step into the room you can't help looking into the mirror 
that is placed on the floor. A terrible red eye catches your sight 
and disintegrates your soul.

Rooms.Name: The Entrance to the Dungeons
Rooms.Description:
You have reached the dungeons where the Elves keep their prisoners. 
It doesn't look like anyone has been here for a long time and you 
start to wonder if there are any living creatures in them.

Exits.Description: You see the dungeons of the Elves.
You see the tunnel up to the fireplace.

Rooms.Name: In the Dungeons
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the dungeons under the great elven house. As 
you turn around you can't see from which way you came.....or where 
you should go next.

Exits.Description: You see old prison cells.
You see the dungeons continue.
You see the dungeons continue.

Rooms.Name: Lost in the Dungeons
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the dungeons where the elves keep their 
prisoners. Strange sounds can be heard from the old cells and you 
wish you hadn't come here.

Exits.Description: You see nothing special.
You see old prison cells.
You see the dungeons continue.
You see the dungeons continue.

Rooms.Name: Lost in the Dungeons
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the dungeons where the elves keep their 
prisoners. Strange sounds can be heard from the old cells and you 
wish you hadn't come here.

Exits.Description: You see nothing special.
You see old prison cells.
You see the dungeons continue.
You see the dungeons continue.

Rooms.Name: Lost in the Dungeons
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the dungeons where the elves keep their 
prisoners. Strange sounds can be heard from the old cells and you 
wish you hadn't come here. Some sort of strange smell is coming 
from the south.

Exits.Description: You see old prison cells.
You see nothing special.
You see the entrance to a big cave.
You see the exit from the dungeons.

Rooms.Name: Lost in the Dungeons
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in the dungeons where the elves keep their 
prisoners. Strange sounds can be heard from the old cells and you 
wish you hadn't come here.

Exits.Description: You see nothing special.
You see old prison cells.
You see the dungeons continue.
You see the dungeons continue.

Rooms.Name: The Lair of the Two-Horned Beast
Rooms.Description:
You have entered the lair where a great beast has been held captured
for ages. On the floor lots of bones from humans and other creatures can 
be seen and you wonder where they came from. As you stand here you feel 
the noise of some foul creature in the back of you neck.

Exits.Description: You see the exit from the lair.

Rooms.Name: The Elf Haven
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the place where the swift stream comes into a 
mighty river. Here are many of the boats the elves use when they 
like to travel on the river and these grey vessels are the finest 
piece of workmanship you have ever seen. An elf can be seen mending 
a golden rudder that apparently must be used to steer the ships.

Exits.Description: You see the trail along the swift stream.

Mobs.Name: elf elven child m4601
Mobs.LongDescription: An elven child is here playing around.
Mobs.Description: The elven child looks very friendly.

Mobs.Name: elf elven man m4602
Mobs.LongDescription: An elf is here busy with his work.
Mobs.Description:
The elven man seems to have lived for many thousands of years. He has long
dark hair and his ears are pointy.

Mobs.Name: elf elven woman m4603
Mobs.LongDescription: An elven woman is strolling around here.
Mobs.Description:
The elven woman is very beautiful. She carries a basket with mushrooms and
she seems to be looking for someone.

Mobs.Name: elf guard elven m4604
Mobs.LongDescription: An elven guard is standing here patrolling the area.
Mobs.Description:
The elven guard is armed with a long sword and a bow. He is very tall and
seems to know everybody passing by.

Mobs.Name: orc scout m4605
Mobs.LongDescription: An orcish scout is here searching for footprints.
Mobs.Description:
The orcish scout is quite small. His skin is dark green and he is armoured
with a black mail shirt and a horned helmet.

Mobs.Name: elven smith m4606
Mobs.LongDescription: An elven smith is here working with a sword.
Mobs.Description:
The elven smith is a very tall elf that has a scar cross his face. He looks
very determined with his work and he is covered with dust and sweat.

Mobs.Name: innkeeper keeper m4607
Mobs.LongDescription: The Innkeeper is standing here serving a meal to some elves.
Mobs.Description:
The Innkeeper is a quite young elf with dark hair and silvery eyes. He is
carrying some jugs of beer and is clad with a leather vest and some
marvelous green pants.

Mobs.Name: cook elven m4608
Mobs.LongDescription: The elven cook is preparing some meals here.
Mobs.Description:
The elven cook is young and seems quite inexperienced. He is about six
feet tall and is dressed in white.

Mobs.Name: waitress elven m4609
Mobs.LongDescription: A waitress is hurrying her way through the halls.
Mobs.Description:
The waitress is VERY beautiful as she is clad in a silver shining dress.
She seems to have here mind somewhere else as she carries a meal to the
elven court.

Mobs.Name: royal guard elven m4610
Mobs.LongDescription: A royal elven guard is standing on his post watching for perils.
Mobs.Description:
The royal elven guard looks very proud where he stands. He is clad in
shining armour and wields a silver longsword.

Mobs.Name: ancient old one m4611
Mobs.LongDescription: An ancient old elf is here telling stories of the past.
Mobs.Description: He looks like a very old elf.

Mobs.Name: monster prisoner creature m4612
Mobs.LongDescription: A monster of hideous proportions is chained to the wall.
Mobs.Description:
The monster is about four feet tall and is covered in old rags. He seems to
observe you as you look at him.

Mobs.Name: beast monster horned m4613
Mobs.LongDescription: A two-horned beast screams as he jumps up behind you.
Mobs.Description:
The two-horned beast is 20 feet tall and is doesn't smell as anything you
have met before. He has no clothes but his skin seems very tough.

Mobs.Name: queen galadriel woman m4614
Mobs.LongDescription: The most beautiful woman you have ever seen is sitting here.
Mobs.Description:
As you look on the elven queen Galadriel you feel that your nerves become
less tense. everything else in the world disappears for a moment as your
thoughts flicker away. She is clad in linen and she wears a golden crown
on her head.

Mobs.Name: king elf celeborn m4615
Mobs.ShortDescription: Celeborn, the King of the Elves
Mobs.LongDescription: The king of the elves is resting here.
Mobs.Description:
The king of the elves, Celeborn, is very handsome but yet his
face looks grim. He is clad in a shining mail and a long sword 
is placed beside him.

Mobs.Name: elf listener
Mobs.LongDescription: A young elf is sitting here enchanted by the stories of the elder.
Mobs.Description:
The young elf seems to be far away over the shores in his minds. He is
clad in a leather jerkin.

Mobs.Name: elf steward m4617
Mobs.LongDescription: An elf is here looking over the boats.
Mobs.Description:
The elven steward is tall, dark-haired and is clad in a grey cloak. He
looks quite busy mending a golden rudder from a ship.

Mobs.Name: elf guard elven m4618
Mobs.LongDescription: An elven guard is standing here patrolling the area.
Mobs.Description:
The elven guard is armed with a long sword and a bow. He is very tall and
seems to know everybody passing by.

Mobs.Name: royal guard elven m4619
Mobs.LongDescription: A royal elven guard is standing on his post watching for perils.
Mobs.Description:
The royal elven guard looks very proud where he stands. He is clad in
shining armour and wields a silver longsword.

Objects.Name: Sword Wrath
Objects.Description: A old battered sword is lying here on the ground waiting for its master.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
As you look on the sword you can see the souls that lie within it waiting
for a chance to avenge their deaths.

Objects.Name: Sword longsword silver
Objects.Description: A long sword made of silver is leaning against the wall.

Objects.Name: mail elven
Objects.Description: An elven mail is put carefully on the ground.

Objects.Name: hammer ages
Objects.Description: An old hammer is lying here.

Objects.Name: cloak elven
Objects.Description: A nice piece of cloth is lying here on the ground.

Objects.Name: silver helmet
Objects.Description: A tall helmet made of silver is put here.

Objects.Name: ring galadriel
Objects.Description: A ring is lying on the ground mourning the loss of its mistress.

Objects.Name: sword goodness
Objects.Description: A shining sword has been put here by someone.

Objects.Name: Mail chainmail
Objects.Description: A shiny set of mail is lying here.

Objects.Name: key citykey
Objects.Description: A very large key is lying here.

Objects.Name: key
Objects.ShortDescription: the key to the elven house
Objects.Description: A small key made in silver is put here.

Objects.Name: wand revenge
Objects.Description: A wand made of pure gold and rubies is lying here.

Objects.Name: orb galadriel
Objects.Description: A beautiful orb that is shining on it's own is lying here.

Objects.Name: rudder golden
Objects.Description: A golden rudder with some inscriptions on it lies here on the ground.
